cases.description: The Secretary uploads a PDF and a DOCX to her personal library and opens the PDF.
procedure: As Member B open "Kho tài liệu" (/mgmt/documents), click "Tải lên", choose a 3-page PDF and a DOCX and click "Tải lên 2 tài liệu".
expected: The upload tray says "Đã tải lên 2 tệp"; both files are listed, the PDF with "3 trang".
The PDF opens in the viewer with its pages.
cases.aiNote: BF-02 · UC-39, UC-37 · 5.2: DOC_FT01, DOC_FT07 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF08 20261123-065433-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.description: The Secretary attaches both library files to a published meeting; a member opens the DOCX.
procedure: As Member B open tab "Tài liệu" of the meeting, click "Thêm tài liệu chung", choose "Kho", tick both files and click "Thêm 2 tài liệu".
As Member C open the same tab and click the DOCX.
expected: Toast "Đã thêm tài liệu vào cuộc họp."; both files are in "Tài liệu chung".
Member C sees both files and the DOCX opens in the viewer with "Tải về".
preconditions: TC01 passed; a published Thường meeting with Member B as Thư ký and Member C as member.

cases.description: A member comments on page 1 of the PDF and the Chair replies in the same thread.
procedure: As Member C open the PDF, type "Đề nghị làm rõ số liệu chi đào tạo ở trang này." in "Nội dung góp ý" with "Gắn trang 1" ticked, click "Gửi góp ý".
As Member A open the same PDF, click "Trả lời" on that comment, type "Đã ghi nhận, phòng Tài chính sẽ bổ sung." and click "Gửi trả lời".
expected: The comment shows Member C's name and "Trang 1".
The reply appears under the comment with Member A's name, and reaches Member C's open viewer.

cases.description: In a Mật meeting the same file is view-only for a member; a user outside the meeting cannot reach it.
procedure: As Member B add the PDF from "Kho" to the Mật meeting.
As Member C open tab "Tài liệu" of the Mật meeting and open the PDF; try to download it.
As Member D (not a participant) open the document URL.
expected: Member C has no "Tải về"; the viewer says "Chỉ xem trực tuyến"; a download is refused (MSG159). The same file downloads in the Thường meeting.
Member D sees "Không tìm thấy trang"; the file API answers 404.
preconditions: TC02 passed; a published Mật meeting with the same roster.
